g.desc: MOTOR POWER | Vsys -> 8.94V / 3A BUCK | BULK + BRAKE

g.text: Use NUCLEO-H753ZI (external, via short harness); no bare MCU on this carrier.

g.desc: Use NUCLEO-H753ZI (external, via short harness); no bare MCU on this carrier.

g.text: 5V to E5V; MOD_3V3 returns from dev-board regulator. Do not parallel 3V3 sources.

g.desc: 5V to E5V; MOD_3V3 returns from dev-board regulator. Do not parallel 3V3 sources.

g.text: Program through onboard ST-LINK; SWD/UART signals are also exposed here.

g.text: Four independent 3PWM timers; ADC current feedback requires synchronized firmware.

g.text: Only Vsys, +5V, PGND and CAN_A are used.

g.text: Unused stack nets pass through without local routing.
